description: Jules Planning & Progress API for async coding tasks

tools.name: sessions_approve-plan
tools.description: Approve the pending plan for a session created with requirePlanApproval, letting Jules proceed with the work it planned. Required: sessionId (path). Only sessions awaiting plan approval accept this call; check sessions_get first if you're unsure of the session's current state.

tools.name: sessions_create
tools.description: Create new coding task session. Required: prompt. Optional: automationMode, requirePlanApproval, sourceContext (plus 1 more).

tools.name: sessions_delete
tools.description: Permanently delete a Jules session by its sessionId. Destructive: the session and its history are removed from the Jules service and cannot be recovered. Required: sessionId (path). Confirm the sessionId with sessions_get or sessions_list before calling this.

tools.name: sessions_get
tools.description: Get the full details of one Jules coding session by its sessionId, including its current state (e.g. planning, in-progress, awaiting plan approval, completed). Required: sessionId (path). Use sessions_list first if you don't already have the sessionId; call this once you do, or to poll a specific session's progress.

tools.name: sessions_list
tools.description: List all sessions. Optional: pageSize (default: 30), pageToken.

tools.name: sessions_send-message
tools.description: Send a follow-up message to an already-running Jules session, adding new instructions or feedback while it works. Required: sessionId (path) and prompt (request body, the message text). Use this to steer a session after it has started; use sessions_create to start a new session instead.

tools.name: sessions_activities_get-activity
tools.description: Get the full details of a single activity (a plan step, message, or artifact such as a code diff) within a session. Required: sessionId and activityId (both path parameters). Use sessions_activities_list first to discover activityId values for a session, then call this to inspect one activity's full content.

tools.name: sessions_activities_list
tools.description: List session activities. Required: sessionId. Optional: pageSize (default: 50), pageToken.

tools.name: sources_get
tools.description: Get the full details of one connected repository (source) by its sourceId, such as its name and connection status. Required: sourceId (path). Use sources_list first if you don't already have the sourceId.

tools.name: sources_list
tools.description: List connected repositories. Optional: pageSize (default: 30), pageToken, filter.
